fact: The African Union Commission's status list of 02/02/2026 records Djibouti as having signed the AU Convention on Cyber Security and Personal Data Protection on 12/05/2023, with no ratification or deposit date shown.
system: AU Convention on Cyber Security and Personal Data Protection (Malabo Convention)

fact: Ecofin Agency reports that Djibouti had already ratified the African Union Malabo Convention in November 2023.

fact: Djibouti's Loi n°18/AN/23/9ème L, adopted by the National Assembly on 9 November 2023, ratifies the African Union Convention on cybersecurity and personal data protection adopted at Malabo on 27 June 2014.
